newsitem.title: south korea: Chun death sentence commuted; businessmen freed.
newsitem.headline: Chun death sentence commuted; businessmen freed.

text.p: A South Korean appeals court on Monday commuted a death sentence on ex-president Chun Doo Hwan, cut the jail term of another former president and let five top businessmen walk free from bribery charges.

In decisions that outraged victims of a 1980 military atrocity and softened the impact of a drive to clean up corruption, the Seoul High Court granted leniency to the leading actors in the country's "trial of the century."
The most dramatic decision was to commute Chun's death sentence to life imprisonment on charges that included ordering the 1980 Kwangju massacre in which several hundred democracy activists died.

The three-judge panel also cut to 17 years from 22-1/2 years the jail term for Chun's successor Roh Tae-woo, reduced the jail terms of 12 former generals, kept one unchanged and upheld the acquittal of a 14th general.

It also spared businessmen appealing against their sentences, completely acquitting two of them and suspending the jail terms of three others including Kim Woo-choong, founding chairman of the giant Daewoo Group.
The businessmen were convicted of bribery, mainly involving business contracts, during August's verdicts against the two disgraced ex-presidents.

Chun and Roh were convicted of mutiny and treason over a 1979 coup that launched Chun's political career and led to the Kwangju atrocity. Separately, they were found guilt of amassing hundreds of millions of dollars in slush funds.
Both men patted each other encouragingly on the knee in the minutes leading up to the appeal court's decision.
Dressed in pale blue prison uniforms, the pair stood motionless side-by-side as the panel's dourt within the next seven days. President Kim Young-sam also can grant them pardons.
In a separate session on Monday afternoon, the court passed judgement on the businessmen.
The chairman of Daewoo Corp., a unit of Kim's Daewoo group, one of South Korea's top three business conglomerates, was cleared completely along with the chairman of the Hanbo Group.
Jail terms imposed on Kim as well as the chairmen of the Dong-Ah and Jinro groups were suspended.
